study: final model: state, reward and action axes

admissibility_guard.message: risk_lambda > 0 requires 'drawdown' in feature_names: a drawdown-penalised reward is not measurable from a state that omits the running peak, so the process would not be an MDP

lambda_selection.rule: largest lambda whose validation mean wealth change stays within one across-seed spread of the unpenalised agent

cells.S4_wealth: adds drawdown to the state, reward unchanged
cells.S4_risk: adds drawdown to the state and to the reward
cells.S3_wealth_share: baseline state and reward, whole-share actions
cells.excluded: S3 x risk-aware: reward depends on peak wealth, which the state omits

B1b_true_bah.description: fully invested at the first bar, held to liquidation

B2_random.description: uniform over legal actions, single generator across months
